rules: Every mutating ExecutionRequest must declare target_authority.
ActionCoordinator must be bound to the selected authority_context.
Same-authority mutation is permitted subject to normal action/approval/CAS controls.
A registered ancestor may mutate a descendant only when the hierarchy is known and the request carries a non-empty governance_basis.

UAOS parent-governed descendant changes must read current domain binding/business authority, perform impact analysis and preserve domain-specific validation; governance_basis is lineage, not a bypass.
DOMAIN:X -> UAOS direct authoritative mutation is prohibited.
DOMAIN:X -> DOMAIN:Y direct authoritative mutation is prohibited.
A child may issue a non-mutating parent upcall for diagnosis, replan, research, assurance or evolution guidance without surrendering its selected task authority.
Approval cannot override hierarchy or ownership restrictions.

full_host_level_enforcement_requires: repository-scoped credentials or tool mediation by authority context
and/or repository rulesets/branch protections restricting the raw writer identity
